test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

D _ M _ D P _ K _ P M _ D _ _ K

options.text: P K D M P K M
P K M D K P M
P K M P K D M
K P M D K M P

solution:
Given sequence: D _ M _ D P _ K _ P M _ D _ _ K

 
• P K D M P K M → D **P** M **K** - D P **D** K - **M** P M **P** - D **K** **M** K
 
• P K M D K P M → D **P** M **K** - D P **M** K - **D** P M **K** - D **P** **M** K
 
• P K M P K D M → D **P** M **K** - D P **M** K - **P** P M **K** - D **D** **M** K
 
• K P M D K M P → D **K** M **P** - D P **M** K - **D** P M **K** - D **M P** K

 
• In option 2, DPMK is repeated.

Hence, '**P K M D K P M**' is the correct answer.
